variants.text: After the verdict, Park Ji-yeon kept her head down. Lee Jun-ho's concealment was not minor, but the Judge weighed Park Ji-yeon's document handling and transfer to the investment chat room more heavily. Lee Jun-ho said he would stop hiding that side's story, and Park Ji-yeon faced the broken trust before the lost money.

Even after the courtroom settled, the couple could not face each other. The Judge found that touching the documents and withdrawing the joint savings did more damage than silence kept for someone else. Lee Jun-ho said he would address that side's matter openly, and Park Ji-yeon left while recalling when anxiety became a choice that crossed the line.

After admitting the document handling issue and the loss from the investment chat transfer, Park Ji-yeon accepted a separate disposition procedure. Hearing belatedly about the family member and child, she had to revisit the period when suspicion of an affair had been everything; but the responsibility for letting that anxiety lead to document manipulation did not disappear. Lee Jun-ho admitted that his silence had seeded the misunderstanding, and the two agreed to decide through counseling whether to rebuild the relationship or proceed toward divorce.

After the verdict, what remained for Park Ji-yeon was the weight of a single signature, heavier than the money lost. The Judge noted Lee Jun-ho's avoidance and his concealment of family circumstances, but recorded as more serious Park Ji-yeon's choice to fabricate a power of attorney in order to cancel the joint savings. Lee Jun-ho promised not to keep his family member's matter outside the marriage anymore, and Park Ji-yeon had to first offer an apology and a recovery plan.

Park Ji-yeon kept saying, "I was afraid I would be abandoned too," but the judgment said fear could not shield a choice that crossed the line. Lee Jun-ho admitted hiding that side's matter and said he would settle the related conflict separately. The couple agreed to live apart for a while and handle joint property recovery and legal procedures separately.

The Judge found the greater rupture in Lee Jun-ho's continued concealment of his slush fund, his family member's situation, and the ₩30M withdrawal. Park Ji-yeon's document handling issue was an obvious wrong, but the Judge saw the earlier, continuing silence as what had broken the household. After the verdict, Lee Jun-ho explained the circumstances of his family member and child for the first time, and Park Ji-yeon listened while holding back tears.

Even after the outcome was decided, the air remained heavy. The Judge rebuked Park Ji-yeon's offense, but pointed out that its background had been created by Lee Jun-ho's long-held secrets and unilateral handling of funds. Lee Jun-ho disclosed all the circumstances, late as it was, and Park Ji-yeon remained silent for a long time, unable to forgive easily even after hearing his explanation.

In this outcome, the Judge saw the beginning of the case in Lee Jun-ho's silence and his concealment of slush funds. Park Ji-yeon's savings issue remained a separate responsibility, but greater weight fell on Lee Jun-ho for hiding his family member's circumstances and the cash transfer, making it look like an affair. He belatedly told the whole story of his family member and child, and Park Ji-yeon, even while listening, could not easily raise her head before the trust that had already collapsed.

The court saw that Park Ji-yeon's anxiety had not arisen on its own. The judgement was that the Officetel visits, the late-night calls, and the ₩30M cash transfer being all explained late had let suspicion swallow the entire marriage. After the verdict, Lee Jun-ho said he would no longer bundle handling family matters and hiding things from his spouse into the same phrase, and Park Ji-yeon decided to watch the remaining procedure and rule separately on whether to divorce.

Even in the ending where Lee Jun-ho bore the heavier responsibility, Park Ji-yeon's actions were not made clean. Still, the judge clearly wrote that Lee Jun-ho was the one who first created the silence and hid where the money went. He had to stop leaning only on his good intentions toward his brother and explain, in order, what he had hidden from Park Ji-yeon.

The two crossed the line first in different ways. Lee Jun-ho hid things; Park Ji-yeon looked into them; in the end, both punished each other with money. What remained heavier than the ₩60M that disappeared was the trace of a marriage that had come to trust records more than each other's words.

The verdict did not end with one person's wound. One person covered the truth in the name of family; the other manipulated documents in the name of anxiety. The money that left remained as numbers, but for the two leaving the courtroom, the more painful loss was the trust that had already broken long before.

The verdict divided and recorded both parties' responsibilities.
